resumeText:
Arvind Menon | Bengaluru | arvind.menon@example.com

SUMMARY
QA manager with 13 years in software testing, from automation engineer to leading quality across four product lines.

EXPERIENCE
QA Manager, Vidyut Software Labs, Bengaluru (2020 - present)
- Manage 3 test leads and 38 QA engineers across Bengaluru and Kochi, including hiring and appraisals.
- Define the test strategy and test plans for four retail product lines.
- Built the test automation roadmap and tracked automation ROI each quarter.
- Publish defect leakage and release readiness metrics to engineering leadership every sprint.
- Integrated regression suites into Jenkins pipelines for nightly runs.
- Run daily defect triage in Jira with product and development leads.
- Agree quality gates and go/no-go decisions with product and engineering heads.

Test Lead, Nandi Retail Tech, Bengaluru (2016 - 2020)
- Designed the Selenium WebDriver framework in Java for the web checkout.
- Led a team of 8 testers on regression and system testing.

Test Engineer, Nandi Retail Tech, Bengaluru (2013 - 2016)
- Wrote and ran functional test cases for the store billing system.

SKILLS
Selenium, Java, TestNG, Jenkins, Jira, Postman, SQL

EDUCATION
BE Electronics and Communication, Visvesvaraya Technological University, 2013

CERTIFICATIONS
ISTQB Foundation Level (2014)
